frontMatter.title: Join Our Summer Club Tonight at Claremont Stadium!
frontMatter.summary: Experience Olympic-level fun at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for just €8. Watch local Olympians in action!

prev.title: Join Us Tonight for Badminton Fun at Claremont Stadium!
prev.summary: Join us tonight at Claremont Stadium from 8pm to 11pm for a fun evening of badminton! For just €8, you can hit shuttles like a pro, move around the court with ease, and have a great time. See you on the court tonight!
